content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a static site hosting service that allows users to host websites directly from their GitHub repositories. For digital creators, this means they can host their digital product stores without relying on third-party platforms that charge hefty fees. By using GitHub Pages, creators can maintain full control over their store and products, ensuring they don't lose revenue to unnecessary platform fees. This sovereignty over their digital commerce stack is crucial for long-term success.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind a GitHub Pages-hosted digital product store involves integrating several components. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, such as processing payments and delivering products. Supabase or Google Sheets store order information, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 handle file delivery. NOWPayments enables automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a minimal 0.5% fee, significantly lower than Gumroad's 10% charge. This setup ensures seamless and secure transactions without relying on traditional payment processors.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are restricted or unavailable. Creators of digital products like ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and presets can benefit greatly from this infrastructure. By leveraging GitHub Pages and other free tools, these creators can establish a professional online presence and sell their products globally without the burden of exorbitant platform fees. The cost savings can be substantial; for instance, at 100 sales per month of a $97 product, the difference between NOWPayments' 0.5% fee and Gumroad's 10% fee retains $921 in the creator's pocket.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks empower creators to sell their products globally without platform restrictions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component in this digital commerce stack plays a vital role. GitHub Pages provides the storefront, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script automate tasks like payment processing and product delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets serve as the database for orders, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 store and deliver digital products. NOWPayments' crypto payment processing ensures that transactions are secure and low-cost. This combination of free and paid tools offers a comprehensive solution for digital creators looking to sell their products independently.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a GitHub Pages-hosted digital product store today, creators need to set up their GitHub repository, configure their storefront, and integrate the necessary backend logic and payment processing components. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all the necessary blueprints and templates to get started, providing a comprehensive guide to building and scaling a sovereign digital commerce stack. With this knowledge and the right tools, digital creators can launch their stores quickly and start selling their products to a global audience without platform restrictions or excessive fees.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, use GitHub Pages for hosting and integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This approach bypasses traditional payment platforms, reducing fees and increasing creator earnings. For example, with NOWPayments' 0.5% fee, creators can retain more of their revenue compared to Gumroad's 10% charge.
NOWPayments' 0.5% fee significantly reduces transaction costs compared to traditional payment platforms.

For digital creators looking to sell their products without platform fees, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is a valuable resource. It includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore how this kit can help you establish a successful online store and start selling your digital products globally.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital product store, start by setting up a GitHub repository for your storefront. Next, configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. Then, integrate Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. After that, set up NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Finally, test your store to ensure seamless transactions and product delivery. With these steps, you can launch your sovereign digital commerce stack and start selling your digital products independently.
